spans.s: हत a. (f. ता) 1. Killed; 2. disappointed; 3. struck, (pp. of हन् q.v.).(It is often used at the beginning of compounds in the sense of ‘miserable,’ ‘worthless,’ e.g. ननु भो हतविधे भरतकुलविमुख Ve.iv., or कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन् R.xiv.65, where Mall. renders हत by तुच्छ.)

हत a. (f. ता) 1. Killed; 2. disappointed; 3. struck, (pp. of हन् q.v.).(It is often used at the beginning of compounds in the sense of ‘miserable,’ ‘worthless,’ e.g. ननु भो हतविधे भरतकुलविमुख Ve.iv., or कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन् R.xiv.65, where Mall. renders हत by तुच्छ.)
हत-आश a. 1. hopeless, desponding; 2. cruel, merciless; 3. weak, powerless; 4. barren; 5. vile, low, infamous.
हत-कंटक a. freed from thorns (lit.); freed from enemies (fig.).
हत-दैव n. ill-fated, ill-starred, luckless.
हत-प्रभाव a. bereft of power.
हत-बुद्धि a. deprived of sense, destitute of sense.
हत-भाग, -भाग्य a. ill-starred, ill-fated.
हत-भाग, -भाग्य a. ill-starred, ill-fated.
हत-लक्षण a. destitute of good marks, i.e. unlucky.
हत-वीर्य a. one who has lost his vigour.
हत-श्री, -संपद् a. reduced to poverty.
हत-श्री, -संपद् a. reduced to poverty.
हत-साध्वस a. freed from fear.
हतक (I) a. (f. का) (generally used at the end of compounds) Miserable, ill-bred, bad, संपूर्णप्रतिज्ञेन निवृत्तेन भवितव्यमिदानीं दुरात्मना वृकोदरहतकेन Ve.iv.
हतक (II) m. A low person, a coward.
हतक (I) a. (f. का) (generally used at the end of compounds) Miserable, ill-bred, bad, संपूर्णप्रतिज्ञेन निवृत्तेन भवितव्यमिदानीं दुरात्मना वृकोदरहतकेन Ve.iv.
हति f. 1. Striking, a stroke, a blow; 2. killing, destruction; 3. defect, flaw, मुख्यार्थहतिर्दोषः K.Pr.vii.; 4. multiplication (in math.).
हत्नु m. 1. A weapon; 2. a disease.
हत्या f. Killing, slaughter, Yaj.iii.260. (This word is generally applied to criminal killing, as in ब्रह्महत्या, भ्रूणहत्या, गोहत्या.)
हात्र n. Wages, hire.
